what: Ben's Fusion check F2 (35f4): a Combine Join of two 10 mm cubes 10 mm apart. Fusion gives no error or warning; the target stays Body1 and the tool's cube becomes a new body, Body3 (booleans.md, 'Fusion checks' and 'Behaviour questions': one body per separate piece, the target's piece keeping its id). The same must hold here: Body 1 and Body 3.

recipe.do: Start a new part with its ready-made box, 10 × 10 × 10 from the origin: Body 1.
Add a second ready-made box, 10 × 10 × 10: Body 2.
Move Body 2 20 along x (x 20..30): 10 mm clear of Body 1.

Combine: target Body 1, tool Body 2, Join, Keep tools off. No error, no warning: Body 1 stays, the tool's cube is a new body numbered after the last, Body 3 (Body 2 is used up and its number never comes back).

volume.why: the target's cube, where it was: a 10 mm cube, 1000 mm³

box.why: the target's cube, where it was

tolerance.why: LINEAR (10 nm): the two cubes never meet, so the Join makes no crossing and nothing grows (B0 decision 5)
